body: I know this may sound stupid but how do I change the colour and add heads?

title: Signs and Heads

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
I am nt certain on Sign colour, I beleive it is something to do with MC Edit.
To get heads enter /give <username> 397 1 3 {SkullOwner:<Username>}

replies.author: Arigenn
replies.body:
If you mean changing the colour of the letters on the sign, there are formatting codes for each colour plus bold, italics underline etc.
You can find them here: http://minecraft.gamepedia.com/Formatting_codes

As for heads, /skull [Player] should work on most servers but /give [Player] 397 1 3 {SkullOwner:[Username]} works as well.
